name: Experiment II: native fixed-parameter coupled row sampling
data_model: Fresh base draws. Raw X=.25G+spike_scale*spike_noise on exactly 36 uniformly chosen rows. Normalize trace(X.T X)=60. Gaussian beta direction scaled so norm(X beta)/sqrt(1200)=1. Y=X beta+sigma*standard_noise. Main spike_scale=8 and sigma=.5 match current 1024 design.
row_estimator: M=sum counts_i*x_i*x_i.T/(r*pi_i); c_hat=sum counts_i*x_i*y_i/(r*pi_i). Returned coefficient is native beta(M,c_hat), with BOTH Gram and RHS reweighted. No final X.T reconstruction for row sampling.
parameters: alpha=c*trace(X.T X)/60. Same actual six-method parameter formulas/integrator as Experiment I. Deterministic self-consistent L includes UNI,NORM,LEV and five iterative OPT atom bounds. Recompute all full targets/tangents/OPT if L changes; universal floor fallback. All parameters fixed before sketches and held fixed in differentiation.
discrete: LW h=.9/L, k=ceil(1/(alpha*h)); Nesterov omega=1, h=.9/L, k=max(1,ceil((-3+sqrt(1+24/(alpha*h)))/2)). Zero initial states; execute every step.
continuous: Showalter T=1/alpha, RK4 maxdt=.9/L; HBF eta=2sqrt(alpha), T=z/eta with z-1+exp(-z)=4, maxdt=.2/max(sqrt(L),eta); SOAR s=.5, T=sqrt(6/alpha), transformed w=t*beta with w_second+M*w=t*c_hat, maxdt=.2/sqrt(L). Actual finite-grid estimator is primary target.
probabilities: UNI uniform; NORM squared row norms and LEV direct SPD leverage mixed with epsilon UNI. OPT scores norm(J_i), with J_i derivative of beta(A+delta*x_i*x_i.T,c+delta*x_i*y_i) at delta=0. Exact centered coefficient influence trace minimization under pi>=epsilon/1200. Ridge labelled SPD direct-solve baseline.

inference.unit: 40 independent dataset means, each average of 40 paired sketches
inference.test: two-sided paired t; Holm adjustment across 18; simultaneous Bonferroni 95% intervals; other budgets/robustness descriptive

sampling: Common uniforms across methods/rules, inverse CDF draws. SeedSequence[sampling_seed,data_id,budget,arm.stream]. Independently indexed budgets; no required prefixes. All row multiplicities retained. Robustness shares base draws with main but independent sketch streams; not pooled.
population_risk: Independent future raw row mixture has covariance (.25^2+.03*spike_scale^2)I. Multiply by fixed training normalization squared. Relative population signal risk algebraically equals relative coefficient risk under this isotropic mixture; not independent evidence. Response MSE adds sigma^2. Separate in-design, designated-spike and background signal risks are also recorded.
failures: Retain every output. Zero-response arm deterministic boundary, not random regression data; relative target gaps remain NaN. No residual event stop or execution cap. Nonfinite states marked numerical_failure, no success-only inference. All extremes and zero-spike draws retained.
scope: Only Experiment II newly computed; I remains frozen. No Experiment III/IV or real-data recomputation. New independent exp12 manuscript derived from exp1 draft, preserving all historical source versions. OPT first-order oracle, no universal finite-budget/risk optimality or end-to-end speedup.
pilot: pilot_02 must pass 74 checks before formal generation. pilot_01 retained: 72 substantive checks passed; two zero-risk checks used exact equality and observed 1.0000000000000002. Only checker tolerance corrected to 1e-14; numerical kernels unchanged.
